risk_description:
The nuts of the 12V earthing connector may be tightened incorrectly, which could result in disrupted electrical connection and increased electrical resistance.
As a result, heating may occur when the vehicle is running and significant electricity is used in the accommodation part over a period of several hours, leading to increased risk of fire.
legal_provision: The product does not meet the requirements set out in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
